claimBoundary: Anonymous artifact comparison, deterministic compiler comparison, browser generation, archive, and rendered-DOCX evidence only. This is not factual validation of every package, instructor approval, classroom evidence, paid-model parity, statistical confidence, or proof that every possible course receives the same score.

selectiveAdapterDecision.reason: The candidate produced no aggregate cross-domain artifact-quality win, introduced factual and assessment defects, used 1.90 times the native generations and 2.81 times the measured runtime, and exceeded the browser adapter budget.

pairedFiveDomainRun.summaryScoreFinding: The deterministic 99/A score was saturated: it reported both arms as equal while complete learner-facing artifacts contained decisive factuality and instructional-quality differences.

anonymousReversedBlindReview.protocol: Complete syllabus plus every learner-facing artifact for the three lessons with the largest changed surface count; anonymous A/B followed by reversed B/A in separate Codex judge sessions.

candidateDefects: Separated fragmentation from modernist verse and overstated stream of consciousness for The Waste Land.
Introduced malformed pseudo-source labels and an impossible quiz evidence requirement.
Repeatedly claimed that Kepler's third law is not one of the laws of planetary motion.
Mishandled multiple-body gravity and inserted unrelated Hubble's-law content into the parallax lesson.

mandarin.conclusion: Order-sensitive, therefore not a credible win.
candidateDefects: Taught that 地铁 is the destination in 我坐地铁去学校 even though 学校 is the destination and 地铁 is the transport mode.
Propagated that error through the FAQ, lesson plan, and study guide.
Produced a tone multiple-choice item whose keyed option omitted the taught high-level contour.

baseline.behavior: Structured brief parameters replaced three of the four actual assessment criteria.

largestCompilerDefect.causalHypothesis: Brief parameters are submission constraints, not independent learning constructs. Keeping them visible but unweighted while preserving the assessment's full criterion plan improves construct validity without another model call.

intervention.submissionRequirements: Up to four brief parameters remain verbatim as pre-score checks.
intervention.providerScope: model-neutral; compatible Scion, local, and paid-provider packages benefit

renderingRepair.defect: The narrow numeric column wrapped the heading Weight into Weig / ht.
renderingRepair.repair: The weight column expands from 750 to 930 DXA, the criterion column contracts by the same amount, the total landscape width remains 9360 DXA, and numeric weights are centered.
renderingRepair.result: No clipping, overlap, missing header, broken table, or split Weight heading across all inspected pages.

attachedArtifact.rootCause: The registry promised A14.2 Final (50%), but the Lesson 14 Quiz & Exam Bank document contained no corresponding final-exam content. The export layer was healthy; the assessment classifier and compiler contract were not.

deterministicRegression.contract: A Physical Geology Final (50%) assessment with a contradictory graded-artifact kind must compile as an exam with at least three questions.

premiumProductLanguage.honestyBoundary: The copy removes unfinished-product branding; it does not hide unresolved quality state from the deterministic report or package manifest.
